STEP_SENSITIVE.definition: norm of 10/5us gate YZ difference >50nm (the unchanged F8 minimum effect)

WALL_CORRECTION_SIGNIFICANT.definition: abs(cumulative fixed32 mean signed Z wall displacement) >50nm

CONTACT_SENSITIVE.definition: abs(cumulative fixed32 mean signed Z pair-contact displacement) >50nm; excludes untested indirect rearrangement effects

TRANSVERSE_EFFECT_RESOLVED.definition: Y2 positive gate +Z increments vs BOTH Y0 and Y1 exceed max(50nm,3*(step sensitivity of Y2 + comparator)); does not imply target reached

limitations: Within-trajectory bookkeeping, not a no-wall counterfactual
Two-step differences are deterministic sensitivities, not statistical confidence intervals
Wall geometric constraint is not calibrated near-wall hydrodynamics
Unrecorded ledger components remain missing, never reconstructed from coarse saved frames
